svg.title: First Iradi Civil War, 1992
svg.desc: Areas held at the start of the war in March 1992, the SRI offensive and siege of Talas, the US airlift, and the joint advance along the railway to Kobozev. Border of Irad: Kartalar map data. Base map: Natural Earth (public domain).
